audit_status.source_base: Greek Gospel text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for magi, Herod's fear, star imagery, Bethlehem/Micah citation, worship/prostration, Egypt flight, massacre lament, Hosea citation, Rachel weeping, Nazarene motif, and dream guidance.

verses.restored: After Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king, look, magi from the east arrived in Jerusalem,

familiar.text: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,

modern.text: After Jesus was born in Bethlehem in Judea, during the time of King Herod, Magi from the east arrived in Jerusalem,

original.text: Τοῦ δὲ Ἰησοῦ γεννηθέντος ἐν Βηθλέεμ τῆς Ἰουδαίας ἐν ἡμέραις Ἡρῴδου τοῦ βασιλέως, ἰδοὺ μάγοι ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν παρεγένοντο εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα

verses.restored: saying, Where is the one born king of the Judeans? For we saw his star at its rising and came to bow/prostrate before him.

familiar.text: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.

modern.text: asking, “Where is the One who has been born King of the Jews? We saw His star in the east and have come to worship Him.”

original.text: λέγοντες· Ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ τεχθεὶς βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων; εἴδομεν γὰρ αὐτοῦ τὸν ἀστέρα ἐν τῇ ἀνατολῇ καὶ ἤλθομεν προσκυνῆσαι αὐτῷ.

verses.restored: When Herod the king heard this, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

familiar.text: When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

modern.text: When King Herod heard this, he was disturbed, and all Jerusalem with him.

original.text: ἀκούσας δὲ ⸂ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἡρῴδης⸃ ἐταράχθη καὶ πᾶσα Ἱεροσόλυμα μετʼ αὐτοῦ,

verses.restored: Gathering all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he inquired from them where the Messiah was to be born.

familiar.text: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born.

modern.text: And when he had assembled all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ was to be born.

original.text: καὶ συναγαγὼν πάντας τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ γραμματεῖς τοῦ λαοῦ ἐπυνθάνετο παρʼ αὐτῶν ποῦ ὁ χριστὸς γεννᾶται.

verses.restored: They said to him, In Bethlehem of Judea, for so it has been written through the prophet:

familiar.text: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: for thus it is written by the prophet,

modern.text: “In Bethlehem in Judea,” they replied, “for this is what the prophet has written:

original.text: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Ἐν Βηθλέεμ τῆς Ἰουδαίας· οὕτως γὰρ γέγραπται διὰ τοῦ προφήτου·

verses.restored: And you, Bethlehem, land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah; for from you will come a ruler who will shepherd my people Israel.

familiar.text: And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.

modern.text: ‘But you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah, for out of you will come a ruler who will be the shepherd of My people Israel.’ ”

original.text: Καὶ σύ, Βηθλέεμ γῆ Ἰούδα, οὐδαμῶς ἐλαχίστη εἶ ἐν τοῖς ἡγεμόσιν Ἰούδα· ἐκ σοῦ γὰρ ἐξελεύσεται ἡγούμενος, ὅστις ποιμανεῖ τὸν λαόν μου τὸν Ἰσραήλ.

verses.restored: Then Herod secretly called the magi and learned carefully from them the time when the star appeared.

familiar.text: Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, enquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.

modern.text: Then Herod called the Magi secretly and learned from them the exact time the star had appeared.

original.text: Τότε Ἡρῴδης λάθρᾳ καλέσας τοὺς μάγους ἠκρίβωσεν παρʼ αὐτῶν τὸν χρόνον τοῦ φαινομένου ἀστέρος,

verses.restored: He sent them to Bethlehem and said, Go, search carefully for the child; when you find him, report to me, so that I too may come and bow/prostrate before him.

familiar.text: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.

modern.text: And sending them to Bethlehem, he said: “Go and search carefully for the Child, and when you find Him, report to me, so that I too may go and worship Him.”

original.text: καὶ πέμψας αὐτοὺς εἰς Βηθλέεμ εἶπεν· Πορευθέντες ⸂ἐξετάσατε ἀκριβῶς⸃ περὶ τοῦ παιδίου· ἐπὰν δὲ εὕρητε, ἀπαγγείλατέ μοι, ὅπως κἀγὼ ἐλθὼν προσκυνήσω αὐτῷ.

verses.restored: After hearing the king, they went; and look, the star they had seen at its rising went before them until it came and stood over where the child was.

familiar.text: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.

modern.text: After they had heard the king, they went on their way, and the star they had seen in the east went ahead of them until it stood over the place where the Child was.

original.text: οἱ δὲ ἀκούσαντες τοῦ βασιλέως ἐπορεύθησαν, καὶ ἰδοὺ ὁ ἀστὴρ ὃν εἶδον ἐν τῇ ἀνατολῇ προῆγεν αὐτούς, ἕως ἐλθὼν ⸀ἐστάθη ἐπάνω οὗ ἦν τὸ παιδίον.

verses.restored: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.

familiar.text: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.

modern.text: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with great delight.

original.text: ἰδόντες δὲ τὸν ἀστέρα ἐχάρησαν χαρὰν μεγάλην σφόδρα.

verses.restored: Entering the house, they saw the child with Mary his mother. They fell down and bowed/prostrated before him, opened their treasures, and offered him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

familiar.text: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.

modern.text: On coming to the house, they saw the Child with His mother Mary, and they fell down and worshiped Him. Then they opened their treasures and presented Him with gifts of gold and frankincense and myrrh.

original.text: καὶ ἐλθόντες εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν εἶδον τὸ παιδίον μετὰ Μαρίας τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ, καὶ πεσόντες προσεκύνησαν αὐτῷ, καὶ ἀνοίξαντες τοὺς θησαυροὺς αὐτῶν προσήνεγκαν αὐτῷ δῶρα, χρυσὸν καὶ λίβανον καὶ σμύρναν.

verses.restored: Being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they withdrew to their own country by another way.

familiar.text: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.

modern.text: And having been warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they withdrew to their country by another route. The Flight to Egypt (Hosea 11:1–7)

original.text: καὶ χρηματισθέντες κατʼ ὄναρ μὴ ἀνακάμψαι πρὸς Ἡρῴδην διʼ ἄλλης ὁδοῦ ἀνεχώρησαν εἰς τὴν χώραν αὐτῶν.

verses.restored: After they withdrew, look, a messenger of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph, saying, Rise, take the child and his mother, flee into Egypt, and remain there until I tell you, for Herod is about to seek the child to destroy him.

familiar.text: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.

modern.text: When the Magi had gone, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream. “Get up!” he said. “Take the Child and His mother and flee to Egypt. Stay there until I tell you, for Herod is going to search for the Child to kill Him.”

original.text: Ἀναχωρησάντων δὲ αὐτῶν ἰδοὺ ἄγγελος κυρίου ⸂φαίνεται κατʼ ὄναρ⸃ τῷ Ἰωσὴφ λέγων· Ἐγερθεὶς παράλαβε τὸ παιδίον καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ φεῦγε εἰς Αἴγυπτον, καὶ ἴσθι ἐκεῖ ἕως ἂν εἴπω σοι· μέλλει γὰρ Ἡρῴδης ζητεῖν τὸ παιδίον τοῦ ἀπολέσαι αὐτό.

verses.restored: He rose, took the child and his mother by night, and withdrew into Egypt.

familiar.text: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:

modern.text: So he got up, took the Child and His mother by night, and withdrew to Egypt,

original.text: ὁ δὲ ἐγερθεὶς παρέλαβε τὸ παιδίον καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ νυκτὸς καὶ ἀνεχώρησεν εἰς Αἴγυπτον,

verses.restored: He remained there until the death of Herod, so that what was spoken by the Lord through the prophet might be fulfilled: Out of Egypt I called my son.

familiar.text: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.

modern.text: where he stayed until the death of Herod. This fulfilled what the Lord had spoken through the prophet: “Out of Egypt I called My Son.” Weeping and Great Mourning (Jeremiah 31:1–25)

original.text: καὶ ἦν ἐκεῖ ἕως τῆς τελευτῆς Ἡρῴδου· ἵνα πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν ⸀ὑπὸ κυρίου διὰ τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος· Ἐξ Αἰγύπτου ἐκάλεσα τὸν υἱόν μου.

verses.restored: Then Herod, seeing that he had been mocked by the magi, was exceedingly enraged, and he sent and killed all the boys in Bethlehem and in all its borders from two years old and under, according to the time he had carefully learned from the magi.

familiar.text: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently enquired of the wise men.

modern.text: When Herod saw that he had been outwitted by the Magi, he was filled with rage. Sending orders, he put to death all the boys in Bethlehem and its vicinity who were two years old and under, according to the time he had learned from the Magi.

original.text: Τότε Ἡρῴδης ἰδὼν ὅτι ἐνεπαίχθη ὑπὸ τῶν μάγων ἐθυμώθη λίαν, καὶ ἀποστείλας ἀνεῖλεν πάντας τοὺς παῖδας τοὺς ἐν Βηθλέεμ καὶ ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ὁρίοις αὐτῆς ἀπὸ διετοῦς καὶ κατωτέρω, κατὰ τὸν χρόνον ὃν ἠκρίβωσεν παρὰ τῶν μάγων.

verses.restored: Then what was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying:

familiar.text: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying,

modern.text: Then what was spoken through the prophet Jeremiah was fulfilled:

original.text: τότε ἐπληρώθη τὸ ῥηθὲν ⸀διὰ Ἰερεμίου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος·

verses.restored: A voice was heard in Ramah, weeping and great mourning: Rachel weeping for her children, and she would not be comforted, because they are no more.

familiar.text: In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.

modern.text: “A voice is heard in Ramah, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more.” The Return to Nazareth (Luke 2:39–40)

original.text: Φωνὴ ἐν Ῥαμὰ ⸀ἠκούσθη, κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὀδυρμὸς πολύς· Ῥαχὴλ κλαίουσα τὰ τέκνα αὐτῆς, καὶ οὐκ ἤθελεν παρακληθῆναι ὅτι οὐκ εἰσίν.

verses.restored: After Herod died, look, a messenger of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,

familiar.text: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,

modern.text: After Herod died, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt.

original.text: Τελευτήσαντος δὲ τοῦ Ἡρῴδου ἰδοὺ ἄγγελος κυρίου ⸂φαίνεται κατʼ ὄναρ⸃ τῷ Ἰωσὴφ ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ

verses.restored: saying, Rise, take the child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those seeking the child's life have died.

familiar.text: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead which sought the young child’s life.

modern.text: “Get up!” he said. “Take the Child and His mother and go to the land of Israel, for those seeking the Child’s life are now dead.”

original.text: λέγων· Ἐγερθεὶς παράλαβε τὸ παιδίον καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ πορεύου εἰς γῆν Ἰσραήλ, τεθνήκασιν γὰρ οἱ ζητοῦντες τὴν ψυχὴν τοῦ παιδίου.

verses.restored: He rose, took the child and his mother, and entered the land of Israel.

familiar.text: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

modern.text: So Joseph got up, took the Child and His mother, and went to the land of Israel.

original.text: ὁ δὲ ἐγερθεὶς παρέλαβε τὸ παιδίον καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ ⸀εἰσῆλθεν εἰς γῆν Ἰσραήλ.

verses.restored: But hearing that Archelaus ruled Judea in place of his father Herod, he feared to go there. Being warned in a dream, he withdrew into the regions of Galilee.

familiar.text: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judaea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:

modern.text: But when he learned that Archelaus was reigning in Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there. And having been warned in a dream, he withdrew to the district of Galilee,

original.text: ἀκούσας δὲ ὅτι Ἀρχέλαος ⸀βασιλεύει τῆς Ἰουδαίας ἀντὶ ⸂τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ Ἡρῴδου⸃ ἐφοβήθη ἐκεῖ ἀπελθεῖν· χρηματισθεὶς δὲ κατʼ ὄναρ ἀνεχώρησεν εἰς τὰ μέρη τῆς Γαλιλαίας,

verses.restored: He came and dwelled in a city called Nazareth, so that what was spoken through the prophets might be fulfilled: He will be called a Nazarene.

familiar.text: And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.

modern.text: and he went and lived in a town called Nazareth. So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophets: “He will be called a Nazarene.”

original.text: καὶ ἐλθὼν κατῴκησεν εἰς πόλιν λεγομένην Ναζαρέτ, ὅπως πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ τῶν προφητῶν ὅτι Ναζωραῖος κληθήσεται.
